verdict.rationale: Dover publishes an llms.txt at docs.dover.com, and a live probe confirmed it returns HTTP 200 with a structured index of the docs site. Every docs page is also served as Markdown by adding `.md` to its path, giving agents clean, machine-readable docs. The 404 on the bare root `/.md` path does not contradict per-page Markdown, since many cited doc URLs are themselves `.md` pages. missing for 10: no evidence of an llms-full.txt or single-file full-docs bundle, and the root `/.md` path does not resolve.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: PROBE llms.txt: HTTP 200 at https://docs.dover.com/llms.txt # Dover Docs
Every page is also served as Markdown: add `.md` to its path
